## Tables

| Table | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [amenities](#amenities) | Reference list of features a space can have (covered, EV charger, gate, ...). |
| [audit_log](#audit_log) | Append-only record of financial and reservation operations (a trigger rejects update, delete and truncate). |
| [auth_tokens](#auth_tokens) | One-time and refresh tokens (refresh, e-mail verification, phone code, password reset). Table and entity exist, no endpoint uses them yet. |
| [availability_exceptions](#availability_exceptions) | One-off periods: BLOCKED (not bookable) or OPEN (extra opening). |
| [availability_rules](#availability_rules) | Weekly opening hours of a space (ISO day of week, local start and end time, optional validity dates). |
| [evacuation_fees](#evacuation_fees) | Itemized evacuation charges of a reservation: FEE rows and the REFUND rows that reverse them in full (PARI-88). |
| [notifications](#notifications) | In-app notifications for a user, created from reservation events. |
| [parking_spots](#parking_spots) | A parking space offered by an owner: address, coordinates (PostGIS location is generated from lat/lng), size, hourly price, status, occupancy, cached rating. |
| [payment_methods](#payment_methods) | Tokenised cards of a user (provider reference, brand, last four digits). No card numbers are stored. |
| [payments](#payments) | Money movements of a reservation with the payment provider: CHARGE, PENALTY, REFUND, EVAC_FEE (an evacuation fee, PARI-88), each PENDING, SUCCEEDED or FAILED. |
| [payouts](#payouts) | The owner's settlement for one reservation (soft escrow): gross, commission, net, released after release_at. |
| [platform_settings](#platform_settings) | Tunable business values (commission, fees, timeouts) read through PlatformSettings; some are placeholders. |
| [premium_subscriptions](#premium_subscriptions) | Owner Premium plans (0% commission, priority in search). |
| [report_messages](#report_messages) | Messages in a report thread. Not used by an endpoint yet. |
| [reports](#reports) | Complaints about a reservation. Table and entity exist, no endpoint uses them yet. |
| [reservations](#reservations) | A booking of a space for a time range, with the price snapshot, access codes and the session times. The exclusion constraint reservations_no_overlap forbids two slot-holding reservations of the same space (unit) overlapping. |
| [reviews](#reviews) | A driver's rating of a space after a COMPLETED reservation; one per reservation and author. |
| [sanctions](#sanctions) | Warnings, blocks and unblocks issued to a user, from a ticket or by an unblock without a ticket. History is never deleted (support API). |
| [spot_amenities](#spot_amenities) | Many-to-many link between spaces and amenities. |
| [spot_units](#spot_units) | The bookable spaces of a listing (PARI-65): a stable id, a display label, soft-deleted when removed. |
| [spot_photos](#spot_photos) | Photos of a space; storage_key points to a file in the media directory. |
| [support_penalties](#support_penalties) | Penalties support assessed on a ticket's reservation: PENDING, CHARGED, WAIVED or FAILED (PARI-87). |
| [user_roles](#user_roles) | Roles of a user: DRIVER, OWNER, VERIFIER, SUPPORT, ADMIN. |
| [users](#users) | Every account. A person can hold several roles (see user_roles); active_role is the one used by the UI. The phone number is stored encrypted (phone_enc) and found through phone_hash. |
| [vehicles](#vehicles) | Cars of a driver; a reservation points at one of them. |
| [verification_requests](#verification_requests) | A request to inspect a space (F10). Created when the owner asks for it while adding a space; no endpoint handles the inspection yet. |
| [withdrawals](#withdrawals) | An owner's withdrawal of released money to a bank account (IBAN stored encrypted). |

## evacuation_fees

Itemized evacuation charges of a reservation (PARI-88). Rows are never updated: a FEE is a charge, a REFUND reverses exactly one FEE in full. The evacuation total is the sum of CHARGED fees minus the refunds.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no |  | PK |
| `reservation_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> reservations.id |
| `ticket_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> reports.id |
| `kind` | varchar(10) | no |  | FEE or REFUND |
| `amount_minor` | bigint | no |  | greater than 0 |
| `status` | varchar(10) | no |  | CHARGED, FAILED (payment refused, does not count) or REFUNDED |
| `reason` | text | no |  |  |
| `operation_key` | varchar(200) | no |  | unique; a retried command finds the existing row |
| `payment_id` | uuid | yes |  | FK -> payments.id |
| `refunds_fee_id` | uuid | yes |  | FK -> evacuation_fees.id; set exactly for REFUND rows |
| `created_by` | uuid | no |  | FK -> users.id |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamptz | no | `now()` |  |
| `version` | bigint | no | `0` |  |

Indexes: `evacuation_fees_reservation_idx (reservation_id)`, unique `evacuation_fees_one_refund_uq (refunds_fee_id) WHERE refunds_fee_id IS NOT NULL` (a fee is refunded at most once).

## reservations

A booking of a space for a time range, with the price snapshot, access codes and the session times. The exclusion constraint reservations_no_overlap forbids two slot-holding reservations of the same space (unit) overlapping.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no |  | PK |
| `code` | varchar(30) | no |  | unique |
| `spot_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> parking_spots.id |
| `unit_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> spot_units.id; the space that is held (PARI-65). A trigger fills it with the first live space of the spot when an insert leaves it out |
| `unit_label` | varchar(20) | no |  | the label of the space when the reservation was made |
| `driver_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> users.id |
| `vehicle_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> vehicles.id |
| `starts_at` | timestamptz | no |  |  |
| `ends_at` | timestamptz | no |  |  |
| `status` | varchar(20) | no |  |  |
| `hourly_rate_minor` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `spot_cost_minor` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `service_fee_minor` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `total_minor` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `commission_minor` | bigint | no |  |  |
| `pin_code` | varchar(10) | yes |  |  |

Rules enforced by the database:

- `reservations_check` (check): `CHECK ((ends_at > starts_at))`
- `reservations_commission_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((commission_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_final_cost_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((final_cost_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_hourly_rate_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((hourly_rate_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_no_overlap` (exclusion): `EXCLUDE USING gist (spot_id WITH =, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING_PAYMENT'::character varying, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying])::text[])))`
- `reservations_overstay_penalty_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((overstay_penalty_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_service_fee_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((service_fee_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_spot_cost_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((spot_cost_minor >= 0))`
- `reservations_status_check` (check): `CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING_PAYMENT'::character varying, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying, 'COMPLETED'::character varying, 'CANCELLED'::character varying, 'REJECTED'::character varying, 'EXPIRED'::character varying])::text[])))`
- `reservations_total_minor_check` (check): `CHECK ((total_minor >= 0))`

Indexes:

- `reservations_code_key`: `btree (code)`
- `reservations_driver_idx`: `btree (driver_id, status)`
- `reservations_no_overlap`: `gist (spot_id, tstzrange(starts_at, ends_at, '[)'::text)) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING_PAYMENT'::character varying, 'PENDING_APPROVAL'::character varying, 'CONFIRMED'::character varying, 'IN_PROGRESS'::character varying])::text[]))`
- `reservations_spot_idx`: `btree (spot_id, starts_at)`
- `reservations_status_idx`: `btree (status, ends_at)`

## spot_units

The bookable spaces of a listing (PARI-65, ADR 0006). A reservation holds one unit; the exclusion constraint on reservations is keyed on `unit_id`. Every listing has at least one unit; the migration created `#1` for each existing listing.

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | uuid | no |  | PK |
| `spot_id` | uuid | no |  | FK -> parking_spots.id, cascade |
| `label` | varchar(20) | no |  | display only, not blank |
| `ordinal` | integer | no |  | creation order inside the listing, greater than 0, never reused; unique with `spot_id` |
| `removed_at` | timestamptz | yes |  | set when the space was removed; the row stays for old reservations |
| `occupancy` | varchar(20) | no | `FREE` | `FREE` or `OCCUPIED`; changed by check-in and check-out (PARI-65 part 3) |
| `created_at` | timestamptz | no | `now()` |  |
| `updated_at` | timestamptz | no | `now()` |  |
| `version` | bigint | no | `0` |  |

Indexes: unique `spot_units_live_label_uq (spot_id, label) WHERE removed_at IS NULL`.

## Platform settings (reference data from the migrations)

| Key | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `approval_timeout_minutes` | `60` | Minutes the owner has to accept or reject a request before it expires (PARI-38) |
| `commission_rate` | `0.10` | Share of the spot cost kept by the platform (F18). PLACEHOLDER |
| `discount_12_months_percent` | `15` | Discount in percent for a monthly booking of 12 months or more. PLACEHOLDER from the PARI-46 example, not agreed |
| `discount_3_months_percent` | `5` | Discount in percent for a monthly booking of 3 to 5 months. PLACEHOLDER from the PARI-46 example, not agreed |
| `discount_6_months_percent` | `10` | Discount in percent for a monthly booking of 6 to 11 months. PLACEHOLDER from the PARI-46 example, not agreed |
| `overstay_grace_minutes` | `15` | Minutes after the reserved end before an overstay penalty applies (PARI-37, F19) |
| `overstay_penalty_multiplier` | `1.50` | Hourly rate multiplier for time over the reservation (F19). PLACEHOLDER |
| `payment_timeout_minutes` | `15` | Minutes an unpaid reservation keeps its slot (NF08). PLACEHOLDER |
| `payout_delay_hours` | `24` | Hours after the reservation ends before the owner is paid (F17) |
| `premium_price_monthly_minor` | `2900` | Price of the MONTHLY Premium plan in grosze. PLACEHOLDER, not agreed |
| `premium_price_yearly_minor` | `29000` | Price of the YEARLY Premium plan in grosze. PLACEHOLDER, not agreed |
| `service_fee_rate` | `0.05` | Service fee added to the driver's total (share of spot cost). PLACEHOLDER |
| `warning_limit` | `3` | Warnings before an account is blocked automatically (F22). PLACEHOLDER |
